description: . I was 33 years old working in the private sector and after yet another bad car buying experience I was fed up! I wanted to start a different kind of car company built on Christian ethics and morals. Our faith guides us, but I tell people all of the time that we love Jesus and set out to honor Him, but that doesn't mean your car will last forever! Lol! What it means is that we are always going to be honest and transparent with you. I am a Veteran and a patriot and believe in old fashioned business practices. I wanted to set out to provide a high quality, used car without all of the dealer tricks and deception. What I found is that other people wanted that too! By being honest and transparent we built our small business into the largest independent dealership in the state. In late 2018 my wife and I sold our business in Indiana and moved to Florida with the dreams of doing the same model here while being closer to our family. We did it with the Lord’s wisdom and help! Our company is called Trade Guru because we specialize in new car trade-ins. If you don't know the difference between a new car trade-in and a normal car at the auction, it is a very important distinction. We look for cars that people trade in just because they want a new one not because there's something wrong with it. We don't buy from independent dealers who are trying to hide their sins and pawn their broken cars off onto other people. Florida is full of nice, low mileage, one owner cars and that's what we specialize in. We mostly buy from local, high-line, luxury car dealerships. These are the cars that people paid 40k to 90k for and have been taken care. That's what we want to give you as the second owner! We look for one to two owner vehicles with documented service histories and CarFax's. We allow you to take our cars to a mechanic to help you make a wise decision for you and your family. We price our cars using Kelly blue book and J.D. Power. If you look at CarGuru’s website, all of our cars are beyond fair deals, as they call them! We have our own experienced technicians, interior upholstery workers, body workers, as well as tire and brake workers to help service your car’s needs. You name it and we can do it all. One of the best values I can offer my customers is a drastically discounted labor rate for the life of the car. That means that when you buy a car from me, if anything were to happen, whether it be brakes or even a motor, you will pay a fraction of the labor cost of any shop in town. In addition to this savings, we will not markup the price on any of the parts your car needs, market price only! That could save you thousands of dollars during the life of your car. Our service department is not a for-profit service department, it is to serve our customers and maintain our cars to keep you coming back and buying from us in the future. We go through our cars and make sure we're selling a good product, but at the end of the day these are machines and sometimes unforeseen things happen. You have my word that I will personally answer your call, work to be at peace with you and find a solution to keep you on the road! Most dealers just say, “Hey, you bought the car as is. Have a great day.” That's not who I am! We are easy to deal with and family owned and operated. You will feel comfortable and at ease the minute you walk in the door, I guarantee! You will NEVER be lied to, I guarantee! You will NEVER be overcharged, I guarantee that also! Please give us a chance to prove that we are a great resource for high-quality, cash cars! Discover the 2025 BMW 430i xDrive Coupe, a perfect blend of style, performance, and advanced technology. Dressed in striking Cape York Green Metallic, this used coupe offers a sophisticated look that turns heads. Inside, the Canberra Beige interior provides comfort and elegance, complementing the exterior's vibrant hue. An interior motion sensor anti-theft system and an anti-tow sensor provide added security, giving peace of mind to owners. 2025 BMW 4 Series Entertainment and Technology Features The 14.9-inch infotainment touchscreen offers intuitive control over navigation, audio, and vehicle settings. Compatibility with BMW ConnectedDrive and Amazon Alexa allows for seamless smart device integration, while hands-free voice-operated calling enhances convenience. The audio system includes ten speakers, HD radio, and a touchscreen display, delivering premium sound quality. Real-time traffic data keeps you informed, and electronic messaging assistance with read function ensures you stay connected safely while on the move. 2025 BMW 4 Series Performance Features This coupe features auto start/stop technology that promotes fuel efficiency without sacrificing performance. The full-time all-wheel-drive system ensures optimal traction and stability across various terrains and weather conditions. Combined, these features deliver a responsive and reliable driving experience, making the 430i xDrive a compelling choice for those seeking a sporty, efficient, and secure vehicle.

The 2020 Kia Optima LX is a practical and value-driven midsize sedan that blends comfort, efficiency, and modern technology into an affordable package. As the base trim in the Optima lineup, the LX delivers a well-rounded driving experience while still offering a surprisingly generous list of standard features, making it an appealing option for daily commuters and small families alike.

Under the hood, the Optima LX is powered by a 2.4-liter inline-four engine that produces 185 horsepower and 178 lb-ft of torque. This engine is paired with a smooth 6-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive, delivering predictable and steady acceleration suited for everyday driving. Fuel efficiency is another strong point, with the sedan achieving up to 29 mpg combined, making it a cost-effective choice for long commutes and highway travel.

From a design perspective, the 2020 Optima LX features a clean and modern exterior. Its sleek profile, signature tiger-nose grille, and subtle chrome accents give it a refined yet approachable look. While it may not be as aggressive as sportier trims, the LX maintains a timeless design that appeals to a wide range of drivers.

Inside, the cabin offers a comfortable and spacious environment with seating for five passengers. With generous legroom in both the front and rear seats and a total interior volume exceeding 120 cubic feet, the Optima feels roomy for a midsize sedan. Cloth upholstery comes standard, along with a user-friendly layout that prioritizes practicality. The trunk provides 15.9 cubic feet of cargo space, which is competitive within its class and ideal for groceries, luggage, or daily errands.

Technology is a highlight, even in the base trim. The Optima LX includes an 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, Bluetooth connectivity, and a six-speaker audio system. These features ensure drivers stay connected and entertained without needing to upgrade to higher trims.

Safety is another area where the Optima LX excels. Standard driver-assistance features include forward collision warning, automatic emergency braking, lane-keeping assist, blind-spot monitoring, and rear cross-traffic alert. These technologies enhance driver confidence and contribute to the vehicles strong overall safety profile.

On the road, the Optima LX prioritizes comfort and ease of use. Its suspension is tuned for a balanced ride, offering stability and composed handling while remaining easy to maneuver in urban settings.

Overall, the 2020 Kia Optima LX stands out as a reliable, efficient, and well-equipped sedan.   • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
